text:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — customers keep asking for a much lighter on‑prem package that works for strict net‑restricted environments. can we sketch an MVP scope?
Mira Patel: +1. we should separate two asks: 1) smaller footprint installer (no optional deps), 2) explicit airgap bundle for net‑blocked sites.
Samir Khan: For footprint: remove telemetry, optional postgres, and default to sqlite for single‑node. rough delta: -30–40% image size.
Nia Rivera: For airgap we need deterministic installer hashes and an offline operator. also KMS integration path for HSM customers.
Raul Gomez: Customers also want a clear upgrade path. they fear that installing the tiny bundle will block them from future rolling upgrades. proposal: include a conversion tool that expands to full distro during upgrade.
Alex Chen: Good point. launch criteria idea: (a) install in ≤30 min on isolated VM, (b) documented rollback steps, (c) explicit upgrade path tested between v1.0 -> v1.1 -> v1.2.
Kathy Li: We should codify compatibility matrix: "airgap-lite v1.x -> full distro v1.x" supported, but cross‑minor upgrades require conversion. also define a support window (6 months) for lite channel.
Samir Khan: Implementation notes: keep the runtime image identical to hosted variant to avoid model-serving incompatibilities. only slim the control plane and tooling.
Mira Patel: Prioritization: customers with regulated workloads (finance, health) move to top. propose OKR: ship lite airgap for 2 pilot customers by end of quarter.
Nia Rivera: Security checklist: signed artifacts, offline KMS keys, ephemeral admin token generation, and audit log export. must have automated verification script.
Raul Gomez: Ops ask: include a small network handshake helper that validates routes to allowed endpoints (for hybrid setups). that would reduce field confusion.
Alex Chen: Can we estimate eng effort? Samir?
Samir Khan: Rough T‑shirt: 3 sprints (control plane slim + installer + upgrade converter) + 1 sprint for customer pilots and docs.
Kathy Li: UX/Docs: include a decision tree for customers choosing lite vs full: scale, upgrade frequency, security constraints. also template comms for customers doing conversion.
Mira Patel: Risk: fragmentation and long tail of versions. mitigation: enforce strong migration tooling and automated compatibility tests in CI.
Alex Chen: Action items: 1) Samir to draft tech spec for installer & converter (due in 5 days). 2) Nia to draft security checklist and KMS patterns (7 days). 3) Raul to prototype handshake helper (spike, 2 weeks). 4) Kathy + Mira to prepare customer pilot invite list.
deploy-bot: Deployment note: created epic #PRIV-LOWFOOTPRINT and linked this thread.
Samir Khan: noted — i'll put the high‑level architecture doc in the epic and tag eng‑runtime and eng‑platform.
Mira Patel: thanks all — i'll schedule a 30m sync after the spec is up. :calendar: :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: thanks — want to keep this high velocity. small MVP, clear upgrade story, pilot customers only.
Kathy Li: ping me if you want help drafting the decision tree.
Nia Rivera: I'll add the automated verification checklist to the repo as a starter script.
Raul Gomez: will share a short demo of the route validator in the spike channel when ready.
